author: Toaster_pilot
quote:
Let me start by emphasizing that I have +4000 hours in GTA5/GTA online, so this isn't coming from someone with a grudge against a new game or Rockstar. I went into with fingers crossed that we would get something special.

13 years and over a billion dollars should have produced something groundbreaking. Maybe if this had been a launch title with the current gen of consoles would its performance have been sufficient, but at this point it already feels dated upon release. GTA5 and RDR2 set a bar that, all things considered, GTA6 just doesn't overcome. 

Unfortunately with multiple critics confirming their negative reviews being removed or hidden, there's no chance this won't bully its way to a GOTY title that it just simply doesn't deserve.
